meta.description: Register for {festival} {year} at {venue}. Get your QR entry pass and enter the daily lucky draw.

common.offlineBanner: You're offline. Your saved pass still works.
common.installPrompt: Install the festival app to open your pass quickly at the gate, even without internet.
common.installIos: On iPhone: tap the Share button, then “Add to Home Screen”.

home.perkDraw: Register to enter the daily lucky draw
home.perkDrawText: Every day you check in, you're entered into that day's draw for book hampers and author-signed copies.
home.perkQuick: Quick entry with a QR pass
home.perkQuickText: Show your pass at the gate, or check yourself in at the entrance poster.
home.perkOfflineText: Save the pass on your phone and open it even when the network is busy.

register.title: Register for {festival} {year}
register.intro: It takes a minute. You'll get a QR entry pass straight away.
register.closed: Registration is closed right now. Please check back later.
register.consentLabel: I agree to the organisers collecting and using my details for festival registration, entry, attendance tracking and lucky draw communication.
register.alreadyRegisteredText: This mobile number already has a pass. Open it on My Pass using your pass code or the email you registered with.
register.alreadyRegisteredRedirect: You're already registered — taking you to your pass.
register.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Please wait a few minutes and try again.
register.error: Something went wrong. Please try again.
register.noDays: Festival days haven't been announced yet.

pass.title: Entry pass
pass.confirmText: Show this QR code at the gate, or check yourself in at the entrance poster. Save it to your phone now.
pass.datesAdded: We've added the new days you picked.
pass.existing: You're already registered. Here's your pass.
pass.savedOffline: Saved on this phone — opens without internet.
pass.saveTip: Tip: take a screenshot as a backup.
pass.selfCheckinHint: At the venue? Scan the self check-in poster at the entrance.
pass.invalidHint: Check the link, or find your pass on My Pass.

myPass.title: Find my pass
myPass.intro: Enter your mobile number and either your pass code or the email you registered with.
myPass.notFound: We couldn't find a pass with those details. Check them and try again.
myPass.savedPass: Open the pass saved on this phone

savedPass.title: Saved pass
savedPass.none: No pass is saved on this phone yet.
savedPass.offlineNote: Showing the copy saved on this phone.

checkin.title: Self check-in
checkin.intro: Welcome to {festival}! Check in to be entered in today's lucky draw.
checkin.invalidKey: Please scan the self check-in poster at the venue entrance to open this page.
checkin.disabled: Self check-in is paused right now. Please show your pass to the staff at the gate.
checkin.savedHint: Using the pass saved on this phone.
checkin.successText: You're entered in today's lucky draw.
checkin.alreadyText: You checked in today at {time}. You're in today's draw.
checkin.notFound: We couldn't find a pass with those details.
checkin.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Please wait a minute.
checkin.notRegistered: Not registered yet? Register in a minute.

winners.title: Lucky draw winners
winners.intro: Five winners are drawn every day from visitors who checked in that day.
winners.none: No winners have been announced yet. Check back after today's draw.
winners.claimNote: Winners are contacted on their registered mobile number.

organisers.title: Organisers
organisers.none: Organiser profiles will appear here soon.

offline.title: You're offline

errors.notFoundText: The page you're looking for doesn't exist.

errors.closeBeforeOpen: Closing time must be after opening time.
errors.urlInvalid: Enter a full URL starting with https://
errors.unauthorised: You don't have access to this page.
